💡 كيف تُحسب مواقيت الصلاة ولماذا تختلف ق: 💡 How prayer times are calculated and why they differ slightly between sources
تُحسب مواقيت الصلاة فلكياً بناءً على زاو: Prayer times are calculated astronomically based on the angle of the sun below the horizon at Fajr and Isha, and this angle varies depending on the adopted "calculation method" — this page uses the method of the Egyptian General Authority of Survey, which is the most widely used in Jordan and most of the Levant. For this reason, you may find a small difference (a few minutes) between sources that use different calculation methods, and all are correct according to the method they adopt.
المواقيت تتغيّر يومياً بسبب دوران الأرض: Prayer times change daily because of the Earth's rotation and its tilt around the sun, so sunrise and sunset times shift gradually throughout the year. Some local mosques add a safety margin of a few minutes to the calculated times as a precaution — this is not a calculation error, but an additional local practice.
من أين تُحسب هذه المواقيت؟: Where are these times calculated from?
تُحسب آلياً حسب إحداثيات كل مدينة باستخد: Calculated automatically from each city's coordinates using the method of the Egyptian General Authority of Survey (widely used in Jordan and the region), via the free Aladhan API.
دقيقة فلكياً بشكل عام، لكن قد تختلف بدقا: Generally accurate astronomically, but they may differ by a few minutes from your neighborhood mosque's announcement. For important occasions, check with your local mosque.
